snapshots.title: hope-ui source and compatibility
snapshots.content:
Verified package: @hope-ui/components. Source revision: 1dc059fcb9045ea5f066fd6109347f0fdce5a03e. Source is free under MIT with notices for incorporated Apache-2.0 code; the current Solid 2 packages are not published to npm.
Runtime and CSS evidence: solid-js 2.0.0-beta.32, @solidjs/web 2.0.0-beta.32, @solidjs/signals 2.0.0-beta.32, tailwindcss 4.3.3.
The current @hope-ui/components source targets Solid 2 beta.32. This is different from the older @hope-ui/solid package. The examples require ThemeProvider with the hope preset plus both hope/tailwind.css and hope/theme.css. No current npm install command is claimed.
